_source: Open-Meteo Marine API hourly ocean_current_velocity / ocean_current_direction, 2022-01-01 to 2026-10-31 (earliest available was 2022-01), aggregated 2026-11-11. dir = direction of the vector-mean flow (deg, toward, 0 = north); net = vector-mean speed m/s; mean = mean hourly speed m/s; max = max hourly speed m/s; n = hours. dry = Apr-Oct, rainy = Nov-Mar. mon = Jan..Dec as dir/net/mean.
